pack.name: Website Stills
pack.target_tools: Midjourney v6/v7 with --style raw (primary — best photochemical texture), Flux.1 pro (best prompt adherence for complex staging), Google Imagen / Nano Banana (best for clean object work: VLN-IMG-02, VLN-IMG-03), DALL-E 3 (fallback). For VLN-IMG-05 generate at 21:9 and crop to 21:8, or outpaint horizontally.
pack.pack_notes:
THESE ASSET IDS ARE LOAD-BEARING. The website's media loader reads data-asset attributes in index.html and probes assets/<ID>.jpg, then .png, then .webp. The filenames must match exactly or the slot stays empty and shows a placeholder card.
Face rule, applied to every asset in this pack without exception: no identifiable human face. Backs, masks, half-light, crops above the lip, deep shadow, out-of-focus. Where a face is unavoidable, it must be at least half in shadow and never making eye contact with the lens. This is a brand requirement of a discreet society, and it also sidesteps the models' worst failure mode.
Text rule: no readable text anywhere in the output. Where papers, screens or signage appear (notably VLN-IMG-09), they must be out of focus, edge-on, or blank.
Slot cropping: the site's media slots use object-fit cover, so a little edge loss is expected. Keep the critical subject inside the middle 80%, except where a prompt explicitly calls for edge composition.

asset.title: The Verdict
asset.placement: THE VERDICT chapter (#verdict) — single portrait image beside the chapter copy about being doubted, labeled and boxed in.
asset.prompt: A photograph. A lone man stands in the open doorway of a vast, empty, opulent room, seen from behind, small in a tall portrait frame. He is a silhouette in a black tuxedo, jacket on, hands at his sides, absolutely still, framed by the doorway's arch. Warm aged-gold light floods from where he is standing and falls forward into the darkness toward the camera. Behind and beyond him the room is magnificent and abandoned — a marble floor, the ghost of a chandelier, tall shuttered windows, furniture under dust sheets, everything drowned in shadow and legible only in fragments. His face is never visible; his back is to camera. Volumetric haze fills the doorway light so the beam is a solid shape in the air. Vast negative space above and below him; the doorway occupies a narrow vertical band and the rest of the frame is deep, crushed black. Shot on 35mm anamorphic, 40mm, tungsten-balanced motion picture negative pushed one stop; T2.0, shallow depth of field, oval bokeh; single warm practical light source, deep crushed blacks with retained shadow detail, volumetric haze, subtle halation on highlights; desaturated near-monochrome palette of void black #050505, bone white #EDE7DC and aged gold #C8A96A; heavy negative space, level horizon, no eye contact with camera; fine organic film grain, print-film color science; cinematic, solitary, expensive, quietly melancholy. --style raw --ar 3:4

asset.title: The Label
asset.placement: THE MASK section (#mask) — first of three stacked cards. The one about being labeled by people who chose the other side.
asset.prompt: A photograph. A single aged-gold Venetian half-mask lies face-up on a slab of black marble, cracked cleanly across one cheekbone, the fracture running through the metal so the two halves sit fractionally out of true. The mask is hammered and tarnished, a beaten gold leaf surface with dark patina in its recesses, not shiny costume plastic. One warm practical light rakes in from the extreme left at a low angle, igniting the gold along the crack and the brow ridge and leaving the eyeholes as two pools of absolute black. The marble is wet-black and mirror-polished, throwing a soft inverted reflection of the mask that fades into nothing. The frame is otherwise empty — vast black around and above the object. A trace of fine dust in the light. Overhead three-quarter macro perspective, shot slightly from the side. asset.title: The Masquerade
asset.placement: GATHERINGS section (#gatherings) — the full-width banner card at the top of the gatherings grid.
asset.prompt: A photograph. An ultra-wide overhead view, shot from a high balcony looking down into the ballroom of a great mansion during a masked party at its peak. A hundred guests in black tie and floor-length black and bone silk move across a black-and-bone marble floor in a slow swirl, all of them wearing aged-gold half-masks that catch the light as tiny points of gold scattered through the crowd. The room is lit only by hundreds of candles in candelabra around the perimeter and one enormous unlit crystal chandelier catching stray warm light from below; the centre of the floor is comparatively dark, the light strongest at the edges. Volumetric haze and cigar smoke hang across the whole room and diffuse the candlelight into gold bloom. Every face is small, masked, or lost to shadow and motion — nobody is identifiable, nobody looks up at the camera. Long black drapes and marble columns frame the extreme left and right of the frame. Slight motion blur in the crowd from a long exposure; the architecture is razor sharp. Vast, opulent, Gatsby-scale. asset.title: The Midnight Table
asset.placement: GATHERINGS section (#gatherings) — grid card. The dinners: brotherhood, the conversation after everyone else has gone home.
asset.prompt: A photograph. A long dark walnut table set for twelve in a cavernous private dining room, photographed from the head of the table at eye height so the table recedes to a vanishing point. It is late: plates cleared and stacked away, wine glasses half empty and ringed, linen creased, a line of candles burnt down to stubs with long frozen wax runs down the holders. Twelve people in black tie sit along both sides, leaning in toward each other in twos and threes, mid-conversation, elbows on the table, one hand raised mid-gesture. The candles are the only light source; faces are half-lit, edge-lit, or entirely lost in shadow, and nobody looks toward the camera. Cigar smoke and haze hang in the candlelight above the table. The walls, the ceiling and everything beyond the reach of the candles are pure crushed black — the room's true size is unknowable. Symmetrical composition, level horizon. No people, except one figure in a full-length black overcoat standing far right at the edge of the garage light with their back to camera, small in frame and out of focus. asset.title: The Vault
asset.placement: GATHERINGS section (#gatherings) — grid card. The working room: where the system actually gets built, behind everything else.
asset.prompt: A photograph. A small private working room, low-lit, late. A heavy dark wood table carries three open laptops turned away from camera so their screens are edge-on and unreadable, loose stacks of paper and printouts spread and overlapping, a couple of leather notebooks, a fountain pen, two heavy tumblers, a full ashtray. One warm aged-gold banker's lamp at the left of the table is the only light in the room; it pools on the papers, catches the aluminium edge of a laptop and the rim of a glass, and dies before it reaches the walls. Behind the table, floor-to-ceiling dark shelving and panelled wood dissolve into black. Two men sit at the table, both cropped by the frame — one only as a shoulder and forearm in shirtsleeves in the extreme foreground, out of focus, the other leaning over the papers so his face is entirely in shadow and turned down and away. No faces are visible. The paper is blank or too out of focus to read; nothing on any screen is legible; no charts, no numbers, no text anywhere. Cigar smoke drifts through the lamplight. Heavy negative space to the right and above.
